text:
maria-peopleops: Quick help needed. Leo submitted a promotion for Tara from IC->Sr IC with effective date 2026-05-01 but wants comp to start 2026-05-15 instead. Payroll cutoff is 2026-05-14. Can we do a delayed effective date without re-running approvals? :thinking:

leo-eng-manager: Yep, team agreed promo contribution period should start mid-month. I accidentally selected 5/1 in Lattice. What's the minimal paperwork to change?

sam-comp: If you want the promotion effective 5/15 but the approval occurred for 5/1, we need: 1) manager email clearly stating new effective date and salary, 2) attach Lattice approval snapshot, 3) payroll ticket if retro is needed, 4) comp director approval if retro spans >30 days. For a future effective date (no retro) you can update Lattice before the promo becomes active.

leo-eng-manager: This will be future effective (no retro) but I worry payroll will pick up 5/1 if Lattice not updated. Timeline?

jess-payroll: Payroll-bot: next payroll run 2026-05-20T18:00:00Z, cutoff 2026-05-14T23:59:00Z. If Lattice shows 5/01 at cutoff we'll apply 5/01. To ensure 5/15, update Lattice or send manager email and open ticket before cutoff to withhold change until 5/15.

payroll-bot: Payroll run scheduled: 2026-05-20T18:00:00Z. Cutoff: 2026-05-14T23:59:00Z. To delay effective date, include "DEFER-PROMO-TO: 2026-05-15" in ticket body.

tara-ic: thanks folks. Small Q: will my bonus eligibility change if promo is mid-month?

sam-comp: Bonus eligibility is typically pro-rated from the effective date. If promo is 5/15, comp will prorate manager/level bonus accordingly. We'll post exact numbers in the ticket after docs are attached.

leo-eng-manager: I'll update Lattice to 2026-05-15 and also email with the explicit line. Will open ticket if anything slips. Thanks. :thumbsup:
